paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B

model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for two types of quantization: 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit. The horizontal axis represents the block index, labeled from 0 to 79, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^-7 to 10^-4. The bars are grouped by block index, with each group containing two bars: one for 4-Fbit (blue) and one for 2-Fbit (green). For block indices 0-49, only the 2-Fbit bars are visible, with values ranging from approximately 5 x 10^-7 to 5 x 10^-6. For block indices 50-79, both 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit bars are visible, with the 4-Fbit bars being generally taller, ranging from approximately 1 x 10^-5 to 1.2 x 10^-4, while the 2-Fbit bars continue the trend observed for block indices 0-49. The bars are not sorted in any particular order except for being grouped by block index. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding for the two types of quantization.
